My impression is that Trace used to use the value of Prin1 at the time
of installing the trace, while now it uses the runtime value of Prin1.
Is there any mechanism for specifying the printing function at trace
installation time nowadays?  It would be very useful for Libmax;Ftrace,
which is a tracer that uses a Mathlab-oriented Prin1.  (Perhaps it
never worked in the way I say; nonetheless, that way would be useful.)
